summary: Meridian Holdings Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release dated September 29, 2026, updating investors on a Brazilian Provisional Measure signed September 25, 2026 that prohibits operation, intermediation and advertising of online betting and online casino services in Brazil and mandates return of funds to bettors. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanic is stated. The filing is a routine operational/regulatory update with an attached Exhibit 99.1 and forward-looking statements. Watch for guidance on revenue exposure, license impairment and potential Brazilian legislative or judicial reversal risk.
